label: The esse of every creature is received in some principle
paraphrase: OPEN analyst generalization of ST I q.7 a.2 co.: the esse of every creature is received in some principle. The passage says it of a subsistent created form, whose esse is 'receptum et contractum'; the generalization to every creature is the analyst's. It says only that the esse is received in SOME principle; reception in the thing's own essence is the separate STMT-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN-OWN-ESSENCE, and DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN leaves the real constitution of the receiving principle open.
